articles.title: Pir Panjal row roils J&K assembly as BJP MLA refuses apology
articles.summary: A significant political dispute, termed the 'Pir Panjal row,' is creating turmoil in the Jammu & Kashmir assembly. This controversy escalated as a BJP MLA firmly refused to issue an apology, indicating a deep-seated disagreement within the legislative body. This situation highlights ongoing political sensitivities in the region, demanding attention from aspirants aware of India's internal security and governance challenges.

articles.title: LCA design, development issues addressed; have robust order book: HAL
articles.summary: Leading aerospace manufacturer HAL has announced that design and development challenges within the Light Combat Aircraft (LCA) programme are being addressed expeditiously. This crucial development from New Delhi highlights continuous efforts to resolve identified issues, ensuring the timely advancement and effectiveness of India's indigenous combat aircraft project, vital for national defence preparedness and self-reliance in military aviation.

articles.title: 7 Best Sci-Fi Movies About Artificial Intelligence, Ranked
articles.summary: The rapid spread of generative AI tools has moved artificial intelligence from theoretical science into everyday discussions. This shift highlights AI's growing practical significance across various domains, influencing daily life and strategic thought. SSB aspirants should understand AI's swift evolution and its profound implications for technological advancement, national development, and defence strategies, emphasizing the need for adaptable thinking.

articles.title: Katharine Burr Blodgett’s brilliant career began at the ‘House of Magic’
articles.summary: In 1918, 20-year-old Katharine Burr Blodgett began her career at General Electric's esteemed "House of Magic" research laboratory in Schenectady, N.Y. This marked the start of her impactful journey within a pioneering scientific institution. Her early arrival at such a renowned facility underscores her future significant contributions to advancing technology and scientific understanding.

articles.title: Hey Alexa—Amazon may be teaming up with OpenAI. Here’s why that matters
articles.summary: This 'Eye on AI' report highlights key developments in artificial intelligence. Meta is significantly expanding its Hyperion data center, boosting AI infrastructure. Strategic alliance discussions between OpenAI and Amazon are also underway, pointing to major industry consolidation. The report further addresses the crucial debate on whether the current AI market constitutes an 'AI bubble' or reflects sustainable technological growth.

articles.title: No more outages: Telus finishes 125km underwater backup cable in Quebec
articles.summary: Telus has completed a new 125-kilometre underwater fibre optic cable in the St. Lawrence River. This significant infrastructure project provides a vital backup connection for communities on Quebec's North Shore, enhancing communication reliability and ensuring connectivity even if primary links fail. This development strengthens regional telecommunications infrastructure.

articles.title: Canada’s Trio Orange joins forces with Québécois execs to launch Punch! Animation
articles.summary: French-Canadian production company Trio Orange has partnered with Quebec-based animation executives Benoit Godbout, Sylvain Lavoie, and Julie Mongeau. This collaboration is set to launch a new venture, pooling their collective expertise in animation and content creation. The move signifies a strategic development within the Canadian entertainment industry, aiming to produce innovative projects and strengthen their market presence.

articles.title: Teddi Mellencamp Is Calla Lily on The Masked Singer
articles.summary: Teddi Mellencamp was unmasked as Calla Lily on The Masked Singer's 'Red, White & Clue Night' episode, an event celebrating America. This entertainment news highlights her participation in the popular reality television competition, where her reveal transformed the show's guessing game into a more personal moment for the celebrity. The episode aired on February 4, 2026.

articles.title: Indian Army drops colonial-era names, renames 246 roads, buildings and facilities nationwide
articles.summary: The Indian Army is actively shedding colonial-era legacies by renaming 246 roads, buildings, and facilities across its various establishments. This significant initiative aims to foster a stronger Indian identity and remove symbols of the colonial past within the armed forces. It reflects a broader national drive to embrace indigenous heritage and move away from foreign influences, aligning the military's environment with modern India's ethos.

articles.title: The Importance of Human in the Loop for Agentforce
articles.summary: The Salesforce Admins Podcast featured Joshua Birk, Senior Director of Admin Evangelism, discussing the critical concept of 'human in the loop.' The conversation highlighted how human involvement is essential for building reliable and predictive systems within the Salesforce ecosystem. This podcast delves into the ongoing importance of human oversight in technological development, ensuring robust and accurate outcomes in complex digital environments.
